summary_markdown:
The conversation focused on reviewing new features for a client-facing dashboard. Key updates include:

*   A redesigned dashboard layout.
*   Real-time map visualization showing the number of sensors by location.
*   Enhanced chart capabilities, allowing users to select different values and filter sensors by category.
*   The ability to export chart data was suggested as a potential addition.
*   Performance improvements were noted.

Regarding sensor data display, it was confirmed that the dashboard currently shows the number of open sessions per sensor for one specific client (Afa). The ability to show traffic/sensor count across all clients is being developed.
decisions: The new dashboard features include real-time map visualization and advanced chart filtering.
action_items: Follow up on adding multi-timezone support for the client view.
Continue development of showing sensor traffic data beyond current scope (Afa).
